annotations.title: Romania: companies administered by a person (ONRC)

description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base, no account). Use when you need a person's other Romanian business affiliations: related parties, conflicts of interest or due diligence on a director. Romanian companies (up to 200) where a person is currently registered as administrator or legal representative in ONRC public data: related parties, director due diligence. Exact match on the full name, case- and diacritics-insensitive. Returns cui, company name (denumire), county and role (status_label).

name.description: Full name of the person as registered in ONRC (min 3 chars), e.g. POPESCU ION. URL-encode spaces in the HTTP path.

name: romania_person_companies

outputSchema.description: Response body of GET /v1/admins/{name}/companies (documentation schema; the handler builds the same JSON).

query.description: Normalized name that was matched (uppercase, no diacritics)
